person.headline: SE Manager · Associate Solutions Engineer (ASE) Program
person.summary: Solutions Engineering leader with almost a decade across Cisco and Honeywell, applying for SE Manager over new Associate Solutions Engineers (ASEs). I graduated from the same CSAP program I would lead—ASE to Technical Solutions Specialist to Collaboration Renewals SE—with renewal rates raised from below 50% to over 70%. Brings Honeywell Scrum Master and Team Lead experience, CSM/CTPM credentials, and a track record of onboarding engineers domestically and internationally.

ase_program_story.headline: From ASE graduate to ASE leader
ase_program_story.narrative: I entered Cisco through CSAP as an Associate Solutions Engineer (ASE) in 2019–2020—the same program I am ready to manage. That foundation led to four years as a Technical Solutions Specialist and my current role driving collaboration renewals. The arc proves the program works when leaders invest in ramp, shadowing, and enablement: I went from learning pre-sales fundamentals to raising renewal rates from below 50% to over 70%.

program_to_results.outcome: Built pre-sales fundamentals—discovery, demos, solution alignment—in the CSAP cohort model
Scaled into technical enablement, customer architecture discussions, and roadmap influence
Delivered measurable business results: renewal rates below 50% to over 70%; AI-powered team tooling
Prior people leadership—Scrum Master and Team Lead with domestic and international onboarding

why_manage_ases: Lived the ASE journey—I can coach from experience, not theory
Honeywell team lead plus Cisco enablement background maps directly to ramping new engineers
Track record of building systems (automation, documentation, dashboards) that help teams deliver faster
Connector/Stimulator strengths fit cohort energy, confidence, and early customer readiness

Designed and implemented AI-powered automation tools at Cisco for the Renewals SE team.
Mentored and onboarded engineers domestically and internationally at Honeywell with structured retrospectives and feedback cycles.

plan_180_day.title: My 180-day plan
plan_180_day.subtitle: First 180 days as SE Manager — Associate Solutions Engineers (ASE) cohort

30.label: Days 1–30 — Listen and learn
items: Build relationships with stakeholders and teammates
Audit enablement assets and ASE program materials
Partner with sales teams to identify shadowing opportunities for the cohort
Share what I'm hearing and seeing, and deliver 1–2 quick wins for ASE ramp

60.label: Days 31–60 — Design and pilot
items: Define mission statement and value proposition for the ASE team
Design onboarding and coaching frameworks tailored to CSAP milestones
Design and launch a pilot (Live AMA for ASEs)
Strategy update deck linking cohort enablement to KPIs

90.label: Days 61–90 — Scale and measure
items: Scale onboarding and continuous learning across the ASE cohort
Stand up enablement dashboard (ramp time, shadow completions, early customer engagement)
90-day impact review and draft 6–12 month development roadmap

180.label: Days 91–180 — Deliver and sustain
items: Execute 6–12 month ASE development roadmap with structured coaching cadences
Measure cohort progress against program milestones and customer-readiness criteria
Formalize performance development conversations and peer mentorship loops
Present 180-day impact review with ramp metrics, wins, and recommendations for the next cohort

responsibilities: Drive adoption and reduce renewal risk with global sales and enterprise customers
Partner with Renewals Specialists on collaboration and software architectures
Enable channel partners through technical enablement and GTM alignment
Build AI-powered automation for team analysis, reporting, and workflows
